en: This is a vintage postcard. The front features a black-and-white photograph of a tree-lined city street with historical-looking buildings, titled 'Storgatan och Esplanaden, Sundsvall.' The reverse side displays handwritten Swedish text, a green 5 öre Swedish stamp with a portrait of a king, and postmark information. The address is written in Swedish and is directed to Sundsvall.
